category_title: Students who engage in physical aggression when unable to ignore peer provocation
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a table with peers working on a classwork assignment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please continue working on your assignment at your table.

STUDENT: I'm trying to do my work, but they kept saying rude comments to me. I just sometimes ignore them.

TUTOR: Just try your best to ignore them and focus on your paper.

STUDENT: They kept talking about me. When I can't ignore it no more, I just go off.

TUTOR: Let's just keep working quietly at our seats.

STUDENT: I didn't want to fight her, but she got in my face and she pushed me from my seat! She said 'Let's throw hands', so I just snapped on her!

options.A: Provide a detailed instruction of each specific element in the classwork assignment for the student.
options.B: Cue the student to evaluate their performance of targeted behaviors using a self-management system at the table.
options.C: Redirect the student to the classwork assignment fairly quickly and emphasize the importance of staying focused.
options.D: Engage in problem-solving with the student and allow them to move to another table away from peers.
